product.name: Durate Physician Scheduling Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates physician shift scheduling, identifies coverage gaps, and provides intelligent recommendations to maintain full coverage while respecting preferences and compliance rules.

product.name: Durate Cardiology Scheduling Solution
product.description: A specialized scheduling tool tailored for cardiology departments that manages credentialing, compliance, and dynamic coverage adjustments to ensure proper staffing and workload balance.

product.name: Durate Urgent Care Scheduling Solution
product.description: A scheduling system designed for urgent care facilities that ensures qualified staffing, compliance tracking, and rapid schedule adjustments to maintain continuous patient care.
